item.title: When do quantum views help? Complementary classical-quantum representations in multi-view fusion
item.description: arXiv:2610.21395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent studies have reported promising results from quantum machine learning in drug discovery, healthcare, materials science and cybersecurity. Research includes comparisons with classical machine learning algorithms and the development of sequential hybrid pipelines.
